source_text: Est in anima ficus germinans et vitis florens odorem reddens. Pater caelestis agricola palmites purgat. Vitis primo odore floris laetificat: Christi bonus odor sumus in omni loco. Videns initia virtutum, sermo Dei vocat animam ut festinet et veniat.
pass_a_gloss: There-is in soul fig shooting and vine flowering odor giving-back. Father heavenly farmer shoots cleanses. Vine first by-odor of-flower gladdens: of-Christ good odor we-are in every place. Seeing beginnings of-virtues, word of-God calls soul that she-may-hasten and may-come.
pass_b_english: In the soul there is a shooting fig and a flowering vine giving fragrance. The [[heavenly Father, the farmer, cleanses the branches >> Bible:John 15:1-2]]. The vine first gladdens by flower-odor: [[We are the good fragrance of Christ in every place >> Bible:2 Corinthians 2:15]]. Seeing the beginnings of virtues, God’s Word calls the soul to hasten and come.
